mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.school_name AS name, s.school_code AS code, 1 AS type, s.province, s.city, s.district, s.address, s.contact_phone AS phone, s.contact_person AS contact_name, s.contact_phone, s.logo, s.status, 0 AS sort, '' AS remark, s.create_time, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM grade g WHERE g.school_id = s.id AND g.deleted = 0) AS grade_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM teacher t WHERE t.school_id = s.id AND t.deleted = 0) AS teacher_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM student st WHERE st.school_id = s.id AND st.deleted = 0) AS student_count FROM school s WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.deleted = 0
